vectors.description: Swift signer: a complete, valid presentation by key2 while key1 is pinned: the keyid is not the pinned node.
Swift signer: nowMs equals expiresAtMs: EXPIRED.
Swift signer: the requester expected another challenge: NONCE_MISMATCH.
Swift signer: a production verifier refuses a TEST-ONLY key.
Swift signer, FILE, key3: a typed fingerprint that is not the export fingerprint: FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH.
Swift signer: one byte of the signature changed after signing: SIGNATURE_INVALID.
Swift signer: the payload changed (seq 17 to 18) after signing: SIGNATURE_INVALID.
Swift signer: issuedAtMs is more than 300 s ahead of the verifier's clock: NOT_YET_VALID.
Swift signer: requiredTier A2 and the body claims strongbox (A1): TIER_INSUFFICIENT.
Swift signer: a validly signed payload that is not in JCS form (indented): NON_CANONICAL.
Swift signer: body.subject.nodeId names key2 but key1 signed: SUBJECT_KEY_MISMATCH.
Swift signer: the rollback store holds seq 18 for this node, the document has seq 17: ROLLBACK.
Swift signer: the store holds seq 17 with another body digest: EQUIVOCATION.
Swift signer: a FILE document presented in a MESH context with no challenge to match: NONCE_MISMATCH.
